change: Add a Steep or shallow mode to the antiderivative workshop

mutations.name: the slope forgets to bring the power down
the power is raised by two
mutations.find: Q(i){ const [k,p,c,C]=this.R()[i]; return {k, p, n:p+1, c, C}; },
mutations.replace: Q(i){ const [k,p,c,C]=this.R()[i]; return {k, p, n:p+2, c, C}; },

mutations.name: too steep and too shallow are swapped
mutations.find: truth(i){ const r=this.ratio(i); return Math.abs(r-1)<1e-9 ? 0 : r>1 ? 1 : -1; },
mutations.replace: truth(i){ const r=this.ratio(i); return Math.abs(r-1)<1e-9 ? 0 : r>1 ? -1 : 1; },

mutations.name: a + C is counted when the guess is wrong
a half power counts as below 0
the + C is written with the wrong sign
F′ is drawn before the round is right
F′ is drawn as F itself
a call still moves once the round is right
